page.overview:
Who is Max?

Spearhead and Max work with Airtight, Charbroil and other Joes in an attempt to stop Dreadnoks activity in the sewers of New York. They fail to stop Cobra's plan to create a telemarketing scam center, and their new ally, a homeless veteran, dies while believing he saved the Joes' lives.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Spearhead and Max were sold as part of the 1988 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: orange bobcat

Accessories: No one of Spearhead's accessories is directly related to Max. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/88/spearhead.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/88/spearhead.shtml Filecard]
